name: MonarchCallControls
title: CallControls
wrapsNative: Toggle with a round ToggleStyle and accessibilityRepresentation, Menu with Button, Picker (.pickerStyle(.inline)) and Toggle items, and Button, in a MonarchFlowLayout
summary: The controls of a call: microphone, camera, screen sharing, raised hand, reactions, a More menu (layout, low data, devices, connection, picture in picture) and Leave.
whenToUse: On the call screen of an app that runs its own calls, under or over the video stage.
whenNotToUse: For a call that only continues in a small window, use the system's picture in picture (see mini-call). For an incoming call, use CallKit (see incoming-call). For formatting tools, use toggles with .toggleStyle(.monarchButton()).
api: init(isMicOn: Binding<Bool>? = nil, isCameraOn: Binding<Bool>? = nil, isSharing: Binding<Bool>? = nil, isHandRaised: Binding<Bool>? = nil, layout: Binding<MonarchCallControlsLayout>? = nil, isLowData: Binding<Bool>? = nil, reactions: [String] = MonarchCallControls.defaultReactions, isMinimal: Bool = false, labels: MonarchCallControlsLabels = MonarchCallControlsLabels(), onReact: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onOpenDevices: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onOpenStats: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onPictureInPicture: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onLeave: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchCallControlsLayout { case automatic, grid, speaker }

options.name: isMicOn
options.description: Whether the microphone is on. Shows the microphone toggle.

options.name: isCameraOn
options.description: Whether the camera is on. Shows the camera toggle.

options.name: isSharing
options.description: Whether the screen is shared. Shows the sharing toggle.

options.name: isHandRaised
options.description: Whether the hand is raised. Shows the hand toggle.

options.name: layout
options.description: The stage layout. Adds an inline choice of Automatic, Grid and Speaker to More.

options.name: isLowData
options.description: Audio-only mode. Adds a toggle to More.

options.name: reactions
options.description: The emoji offered in the reactions menu: 👍 👏 😂 ❤️ 🎉 😮.

options.name: isMinimal
options.description: Leaves out the hand, reactions and More, for a small window.

options.name: onReact
options.description: Sends a reaction. Shows the reactions menu.

options.name: onOpenDevices
options.description: Opens the app's device settings. Adds Devices to More.

options.name: onOpenStats
options.description: Opens the app's connection details. Adds Connection and data use to More.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Continues the call in picture in picture. Adds an item to More.

options.name: onLeave
options.description: Leaves the call. Shows the wide Leave control.

states.name: device on
states.description: A round control with the muted fill and the default text colour, showing mic.fill or video.fill.

states.name: device off
states.description: The danger fill with a slashed symbol (mic.slash.fill, video.slash.fill).

states.name: sharing
states.description: The success fill with the stop-sharing symbol.

states.name: hand raised
states.description: The warning fill with the filled hand symbol.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A darker fill of the same tone.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The muted fill with the disabled text colour.

states.name: minimal
states.description: Only microphone, camera, sharing and Leave.

appearance: Round controls, at least 48 points and scaled with Dynamic Type, in capsule shapes: the muted background with a subtle border for normal controls; the danger solid fill for a device that is off and for Leave; the success solid fill while sharing; the warning solid fill for a raised hand, each with its on-solid text colour, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web toolbar labels toggles by the action ("Mute", "Unmute") with aria-pressed; on iOS each toggle keeps one name ("Microphone") and VoiceOver reads on or off as its value, as a standard Toggle does. The web keyboard shortcuts (M, V, S, H, F) and roving arrow-key focus are not offered; a hardware keyboard moves between the controls with Tab. Full screen is left out because an iOS call screen is already full screen. The extra slot for product controls is left out; place them beside the controls. The CallIcon glyphs are replaced by SF Symbols. Android ships MonarchCallControls.
accessibility: The controls are one container named "Call controls".
Microphone, camera, sharing and hand are given to VoiceOver as standard Toggles through accessibilityRepresentation: name, then on or off.
A state change changes the symbol as well as the colour.
Reactions, More and Leave are read by their titles through icon-only Labels; each reaction in the menu is read as "React" and the emoji.
Every control is at least 44 by 44 points and the row wraps onto a second line at large text sizes.
edgeCases: With no binding and no action the view is empty.
An empty reactions list hides the reactions menu.
The More menu appears only when it has an item; in the minimal form it never appears.
Whether the button style applies to the Menu triggers on every iOS version, and how VoiceOver reads the toggles, was not checked on a device.

examples.title: Every control
examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
    MonarchCallControls(
        isMicOn: $isMicOn,
        isCameraOn: $isCameraOn,
        isSharing: $isSharing,
        isHandRaised: $isHandRaised,
        layout: $layout,
        isLowData: $isLowData,
        onReact: { last = $0 },
        onOpenDevices: { last = "Devices" },
        onOpenStats: { last = "Stats" },
        onLeave: { last = "Leave" }
    )
    Text("Layout: \(layout == .automatic ? "auto" : String(describing: layout)) · Last action: \(last)")
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
}

examples.title: Sharing and a More menu with the layout
examples.code:
MonarchCallControls(
    isMicOn: $isMicOn,
    isSharing: $isSharing,

    isLowData: $isLowData,
    onOpenDevices: {},
    onLeave: {}

parityExceptions.reason: The web draws a phone with a slash for Leave. SF Symbols has no crossed phone; the end-call glyph is phone.down.fill, the one Apple uses for the red end-call button in Phone and FaceTime.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG SF Symbols: phone.down.fill is the system end-call glyph
